nodes.name: Telegram webhook
nodes.notes: Telegram posts here: https://{DOMAIN_N8N}/webhook/eva-telegram. Registered by scripts/telegram-webhook.sh with a secret_token.

nodes.name: Secret token valid?
nodes.notes: Anything that is not Telegram calling with our secret_token is dropped.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ telegram_id: $json.telegram_id, username: $json.username, first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, language_code: $json.language_code }) }}

nodes.name: Ensure agent + conversation
nodes.notes: Idempotent. eva-agent-service creates the user's Letta agent and its conversation through the Agent SDK, and stores user -> agent -> conversation in PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Run a turn (Agent SDK)
nodes.notes: eva-agent-service holds a per-user lock for the whole turn and streams the SDK response; a 409 here means the user sent a second message while the first was still running.
